title: Allure Beauty Box Alternatives: 6 Boxes Compared - Cratejoy
summary: Looking for an Allure Beauty Box alternative? Compare six beauty boxes by price, choice, and formula, from full-size makeup to vegan and K-beauty skincare.
body_markdown:
## Questions before switching


Which alternative is closest to Allure Beauty Box?


EYESCREAM Beauty Box. It costs about the same, $30 a month, sends makeup and skincare together every month, and the seller says every item is full size. The picks come from the seller rather than a magazine’s editors.


Can I choose what’s in my box?


IPSY Extra comes closest: you pick three of its five full-size products each month. PinkSeoul and FaceMaskTonight build each box from the skin type and concerns you set, and Allure’s September box included one pick-your-product slot.


Is there a vegan box like Allure Beauty Box?


Love Goodly. Every product is vegan and cruelty-free, and makeup is still part of the mix. Aster’s skincare is vegan too, but it sends skincare only.


Is there a cheaper box like Allure Beauty Box?


FaceMaskTonight, at about $13 a month for four sheet masks, is the least expensive option here, but it sends masks only. For a full makeup-and-skincare box, EYESCREAM is the closest to Allure’s price at about $30.


Can I give one of these as a gift?


Yes. The Cratejoy boxes can be given as a gift from the listing page, and gift orders don’t renew. Allure also sells a gift subscription at $30 a box.
